text:
sam: Quick poll — we got a small run of stickers. Which editor should get a sticker on the office pack?
Options: 1) VSCode, 2) Vim, 3) Emacs, 4) JetBrains, 5) Other (reply)
maria: VSCode all the way :vscode: :stuck_out_tongue:
lee: vim. no contest. :cowboy_hat_face:
ashley: Emacs support pls ❤️
praveen: JetBrains for the comfort folks
sam: @lee explain. why vim? :eyes:
lee: muscle memory + tiny config flex. also cats.
maria: I will fight for VSCode's extensions ecosystem. :fist:
ashley: we should do a multi-pack? small v1 with top 3?
praveen: +1 for multi-pack, maybe 2 of the winner, 1 of runner-ups
deploy-bot: Poll created: react with :one: for VSCode, :two: for Vim, :three: for Emacs, :four: for JetBrains, :five: for Other
ashley: adding reactions
maria: :one:
lee: :two:
praveen: :four:
sam: :one:
ashley: :three:
maria: ok tally: VSCode(2), Vim(1), Emacs(1), JetBrains(1) — VSCode wins this round :tada:
sam: Nice. We'll get 50% VSCode stickers, 25% each for the top two? I'll coordinate with ops for print.
lee: can we sneak a tiny vi-mode sticker for the keyboard nerds? :sweat_smile:
praveen: Love it. Thanks for polling!
ashley: @sam assign me if you want help with designs :paintbrush:
sam: Thanks everyone — will post final mock + order link tomorrow.
